projects.title: CampTix Badge Designer
projects.description: WordPress plugin for WordCamp organizers: design attendee badges in a visual editor and generate a print-ready PDF in the browser from CampTix data.
projects.status_text: Public demo and user guide are out, and the proposal is open as WordPress/wordcamp.org#2286. Next: a refinement milestone, then integration into WordCamp.org if agreed.

projects.title: Classic Honeypot for CF7
projects.description: Ad-free GPL fork of the Honeypot for Contact Form 7 WordPress plugin, based on version 2.1.1.
projects.status_text: Version 1.0.2, tested with WordPress 7.1.4 and Contact Form 7 6.2.4.1, is published on WordPress.org and GitHub. No work in progress; maintenance on demand.

projects.title: Cute WP Badges
projects.description: Image generator for WordPress profile badges.
projects.status_text: Cute WP Badges 1.0.0 is released on GitHub. A step-by-step user guide with screenshots is written for the README, waiting for Nilo's review.

projects.title: Flypad Keepalive
projects.description: Windows app that lets you use the Parrot Flypad Bluetooth controller in PC drone simulators by presenting it as an Xbox 360 controller.
projects.status_text: Version 1.0.0 is published as a release on GitHub. No further work is planned.

projects.title: GlotPress Stats
projects.status_text: Version 0.8 is published and the plugin, for translators only, is in maintenance. The moderator features move to a separate Chrome extension, to be contributed later to GlotDict.

projects.title: LadyQR
projects.description: Privacy-oriented QR code generator and URL shortener.
projects.status_text: LadyQR 1.2.0 is published on GitHub. The press kit has its BrandScript and development moved to a Mac with a regenerable test environment. Next: the backlog, such as the encoder as a library.

projects.title: nilovelez.com
projects.description: Everything related to my personal brand, content creation and social media presence
projects.status_text: Talk posts are published newest first. Next: the career timeline from Nilo's LinkedIn archive, reviewed entry by entry, then the event posts of the photo section.

projects.title: PDF Diva
projects.description: Free desktop app that gives any PDF a PowerPoint-style presenter view, for event technicians and streaming operators.
projects.status_text: Waiting for a partner's Apple Developer ID certificate to sign and notarize the Mac build of PDF Diva 1.5.0. Promotion is paused; maintenance continues.

projects.title: Quevedo
projects.description: WordPress plugin with writing-focused tools: removes features single-author blogs don't need, simplifies the editor and adds Open Graph metadata.
projects.status_text: Version 1.5 is published in the WordPress.org plugin directory, requiring PHP 8.2 and tested up to WordPress 7.1. No work in progress.

projects.title: wp-agentic-workflow
projects.description: Public Claude Code skill that sets up and guides a WordPress plugin development workflow, from local test sites to WordPress.org submission.
projects.status_text: The skill is in use on real WordPress plugins and now also runs on macOS (first setup on a Mac mini M1). Next: a plugin started from scratch, and Studio CLI 2.x tested.
